resource: Charms in one CharmViewV1, the largest charm index, and the largest assignment slot limit
allocation_impact: The decoder refuses the 33rd entry, a charm index above 32 or a slot limit above 32 before allocating for it; the whole view is at most 554 bytes (state domain 5).
boundary_tests: max=32: a view of 32 charms at charm index 32 with slot limit 32 is exactly 554 bytes and round-trips
max+1=33: a 33rd entry, charm index 33 or slot limit 33 is refused in both directions
notes: 25 charms in the candidate catalogue. CHARM-5 proposal section 2; accepted by the Sol protocol ruling #162 5907282001. Registered by OTV2-20260930-charm-5-reg.
